name: sealed-array-test-916de22362/sealed-array-semantics-e.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString (not clone).

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: value:cloneWithType; value:fromJsonWithType; value:toString and value:toBalString (clone is absent).
Supported language features (subset 10) > Expressions: Member access expression; List constructor; Method call.
reason: The negative sealed-array case includes int[*] intArr2 = intArr1.clone(), asserting rejection of inferred-length array initialization from a cloned open array. clone is an essential lang.value operation outside both the supported library methods and langlib method-call whitelist. Consequently the whole case contains unsupported behavior even though its array indexing and assignment diagnostics otherwise concern supported constructs.
unsupported_constructs: intArr1.clone(): ballerina/lang.value clone, including its result in the inferred-length array initialization diagnostic
test_design_notes: Negative compile-time rejection remains in scope for supported array syntax; the feature classification is based on the unlisted clone operation, not merely on intentionally illegal declarations or accesses.
